raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The region join is case-sensitive: about 324 POSTED transactions carry lowercase customer_ids (e.g., 'c00052') that do not match the uppercase keys in raw_customers, so the inner join in gold_region_daily silently drops them (4558 to 4234).
